description: Complete guide to Koh Samui, Surat Thani: cost of living, home prices, neighborhoods, remote work readiness, and relocation tips.
content:
Overview

Koh Samui is a city in Surat Thani with a population of 65,000. Thailand’s most famous island destination, a tropical paradise of palm-fringed beaches, coconut groves, and luxury resorts in the Gulf of Thailand. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 7b growing zone supports Mild — wide variety of vegetables, many fruit trees.
